limits: These are recorded automated UI/lifecycle scopes, not independent reviewer device executions or playable native game qualification.

Genuine enabled Reveal and absent private semantics establish the current Standard privacy permission. They do not establish connection readiness, absent pending actions, cleared selection, COMPOSE-versus-CLOSING state, or pixels.
Rejected XML never substitutes for accepted return_before_up. All 13 trees match later accepted XML, but their own earlier state still contains a native ActivityRecord.
No Back/card-drag, physical-device/LAN, TalkBack, iOS, distribution signing, pixel privacy/cover order, or full-hand/internal-session identity result is inferred.
Original recordings retain captured-review-required status; video JSON/ffprobe consistency is not pixel review.
methodology: Used the sole collector canonical originals, accounting for their registered bulk-shm physical paths. No duplicate transfers or archive extraction.

Replayed the exact pinned observer predicates with device calls and external process execution forbidden. Original physical/override display-size.log supplies UI geometry; XML rotation is applied once.
Checked exact native window/PID/UID/control ownership, live sole finger and connection motion memento with no pending outbound queue independently of RecentQueue clock evidence.
Recomputed intersecting device-clock intervals and original before-UP margins. Host input completion and rejected UI receive times remain separate.
Reparsed selected original Activity/WM/process logs and required equality to each original state JSON, including both sides of held target observation and all accepted/rejected samples.
Bound every used original to the collector selected-original receipt and all-member CRC/SHA inventory; installed APK hashes/lengths match current producer inputs.
Compared original recorder lifecycle and ffprobe JSON receipts without media decoding or image viewing.
reviewer_development_note: A first private recorder assertion wrongly required every startup stat to succeed. Pinned source allows missing output before creation; the audit was corrected to require positive increasing completed reads within eight seconds. All active consumer reports use the corrected script. The earlier optimized 1.0 report is retained as superseded evidence-review.json; evidence-review-v2.json is authoritative.
source_provenance: Derived exact-commit source, independently matched to canonical Git blob identities by hashing without a Git command.

standalone_pck.inspected: Independent whole-file hashing only; no extraction, decoding, or engine execution.
